summary: A short biographical note on Jean-André van der Mersch, an officer who served the French King during the Seven Years' War. It names two battles he took part in, the Battle of Rossbach (1757) and the Battle of Hochkirch (1758). It also notes that he later joined the Austrian army in 1778 and retired as a colonel.
one_line: Jean-André van der Mersch was a French-then-Austrian army officer who fought in Seven Years' War battles and retired as a colonel.
key_facts: Jean-André van der Mersch served the French King as an officer during the Seven Years' War.
Jean-André van der Mersch participated in the Battle of Rossbach (1757).
Jean-André van der Mersch participated in the Battle of Hochkirch (1758).
Jean-André van der Mersch joined the Austrian army in 1778.
Jean-André van der Mersch retired from military service with the rank of colonel.
